label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y hizo las tablas al mishkán, maderas de shitím, paradas.
spanish: Y hizo las tablas para el tabernáculo, maderas de acacia, paradas.
grammarChanges: mishkán replaced with Spanish common noun tabernáculo (H4908 must not stay an untranslated lemma)
shitím replaced with Spanish common noun acacia (H7848 must not stay Hebraized)
al (directional) replaced with para el, since the morphology of ל does not specify directional sense
readerNote: Chose para el over directional al for the lamed on mishkán/tabernáculo because the morphology does not specify direction; both are licensed senses of the same preposition.
